 Quentin Grimes’ career night puts him alongside only Kobe Bryant in Lakers history
 Quentin Grimes' insane scoring explosion vs. the Hornets has him in exclusive Lakers territory after comeback win.
 By Jedd Pagaduan • Nov 18, 2026 at 2:03 AM ET • 2 min read Add ClutchPoints on Google Ed Szczepanski-Imagn Images With Austin Reaves out due to a heel injury on Tuesday night against the Charlotte Hornets, it was Quentin Grimes who stepped into the starting lineup for the Los Angeles Lakers . And Grimes made the most of the increased responsibilities on offense that he had to take on. With the Hornets selling out to stop Doncic, the onus fell on Grimes to breathe life into a Lakers team that seemed to be at their most lethargic thus far this season.
 Grimes has answered the call and then some for the Lakers. He went into a flow state from beyond the arc and remained in heat check mode for the entirety of the second half — even draining the game-tying triple that forced overtime against the Hornets after the Lakers fell behind by 18 points earlier in the game.
 That game-tying three-ball was Grimes' 10th of the night, and this bonkers heater has him standing tall in an exclusive Lakers club. According to ClutchPoints NBA insider Brett Siegel, Grimes joined Kobe Bryant as the only players in Lakers franchise history to make at least 10 threes in a single game.
 Bryant, of course, hit 12 three-pointers back on January 7, 2003 in a 119-98 win for the Lakers over the Seattle Supersonics. Bryant set the record for most threes in a single game at that time, and that record would not be broken (only tied) until 2016, when Stephen Curry drained 13 treys in a game against the New Orleans Pelicans. (Klay Thompson now holds the single-game record , with 14.)
 Article Continues Below Grimes' previous career-high for made three-pointers in a single game was eight, so it's not like he's a stranger to this sort of shooting performance. But the degree of difficulty of some of the shots he took, and considering the situation the Lakers were in (fighting uphill against the Hornets), this certainly stands out as the best performance of his career — especially with LA taking a 118-114 win in the end.
 In fact, Grimes just set a new career-high in scoring for a single game, with 47 — surpassing his previous best of 46 points .
